messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Complaint:  today feels like Friday

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: I wish... Then I could be playing some season 18 of W... But it's Thursday and I am covered with work up to my freaking neck

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: I’ll be around tomorrow sir, hit me up.  I’ll just be lounging around singing Dolly Parton songs

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: I noticed your team is on the shame list.  What say you?

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Shame list???

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Well that's a list I don't like to be on but it can't be helped. Hopefully I will be able to get 8-10 games in by the end of the weekend.  Right now work is taking priority and kicking my ass on a daily basis

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: I will certainly hit you up. I just saw that you had a messed up knee so you're not going to be moving around too much so I should be able to track you down fairly easy tomorrow LOL

messages.author: Lloyd10xmas
messages.text: An unnamed individual calling me a name(!)

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: Yeah, it’s just a pain.  Grade 2 MCL and Meniscus.  I’m always hurting myself lol.  Couple weeks with a brace and hopefully 🤞 that’s it! (Still made it out to Steak night!)

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: But will you be ready for week 1, or should I be drafting an insurance handcuff?

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: Oh I’ll be ready and headed to Iowa Sat morning with a buddy to place the season bets!!

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: I want your insurance life, mine is less fun

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text:
Oh, it’s not fun,
Not fun at all.  Hate it every single day.

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Complaint:  Almost avoided a trip to Vegas to go to Poland, but now I'm stuck going to Vegas.

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: Been to both in last couple months.  Vegas as you know is my Home away from home but my goodness Poland was nice.  Gained 10lbs there (Blair broke the Washer/Dryer at AirBNB)

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: When ya headed to Vegas?  I might be there 10/2 weekend

messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Probably get their 10/5

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: I’ll pass ya in the airport and leave a 40oz of St Ides behind the Cosmopolitan for ya

messages.author: Lloyd10xmas
messages.text: Leave him some 🎱 too(!) I hear that helps enhance a Vegas stay(!)

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text: I’m more of a “I’ll have some gummies to offset these 37 drinks I just had” type a guy.  I’m just wondering how I can convince the Wife to see Metallica at the Sphere (maybe I’ll tell her it’s the Back Street Boyz)
